newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia revises jobless figures, Oct rate still up.
newsitem.headline: Croatia revises jobless figures, Oct rate still up.

text.p: Croatia's State Statistics Bureau said on Wednesday it had included army, police and farmers in total workforce figures, resulting in lower jobless rates.
But October rate still rose to 15.7 percent from 15.3 percent in September after the figures for that month were also revised, as total jobless rose by more than 5,000.
Joblessness was running above 18 percent before, compared to around 17 percent a year ago as soldiers were constantly demobilised but failed to find new employment.
The workforce figures are compiled from the Labour Ministry Statistics, monitoring the payment of pension benefits for the workers rather than actual employment.

Since many employers hire people without registering them properly to avoid paying high contributions for them, analysts believe unemployment could be much lower than figures show. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
